headword: {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}

definitions.explanation: A machine that automatically dispenses items such as drinks, snacks, or tickets when money is inserted.

examples.japanese: {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲み物|のみもの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I buy a drink from the vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many vending machines in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: You can also buy tickets at this vending machine.

notes:
{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき} breaks down as:
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic)
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (selling)
- ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine)

FORMS:
- ⟦{自販機|じはんき}→自販機：09703_jihanki⟧ (common abbreviation)

WHAT VENDING MACHINES SELL IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{飲み物|のみもの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧ (drinks - most common)
- ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧ (snacks)
- ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧ (tickets)
- ⟦タバコ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧ (cigarettes - requires age verification)
- Umbrellas, newspapers, and many other items

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has one of the highest densities of vending machines in the world, with machines found everywhere including rural areas and hiking trails.
